## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred call transcripts, but the overwhelming majority are **not genuine sales calls** — they are transporter/trailer-booking calls (Raipur, Nagpur, Tirupati, Tuticorin trucking coordination), internal operations (crane/cutting-machine/coil-cutting instructions to "Yuvraj Operator", MTC/tag paperwork chases, driver/labour/water-arrangement chatter),
